findings.finding: The company's own primary numbers imply that H2 FY26 order intake collapsed to roughly £26m, against about £44m in H2 FY25 (H1 £64m; FY26 continuing revenue £91.6m; order book moved from £32m to £31m; FY25 intake £110m). The year-end book covers only H1 FY27, so the first FY27 outlook statement in this release risks being cautious unless Sep-Oct intake has recovered.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-28 the FY26 revenue-guide cut moved the stock -29.55% over the stage window. When the outlook was reiterated (FY25 finals 2025-11-11: +0.77%; 2026-09-17 pre-close: +1.09%) the stock barely moved.
findings.why_not_priced: Neither the H2 intake figure nor any FY27 statement has been published. It can only be derived across three documents (H1 report, FY25 finals, pre-close), and the company has not said anything about FY27 since July. Had the market fully discounted a weak FY27, the stock would not have recovered from about 751p after July to 844p on 17 Sep and held near 796p, and short interest would be building rather than covering. Against that, the EV/EBIT of about 8.6x already discounts a lot, so this finding is capped small.
findings.independence: The 2026-07-28 trading update says 'lower level of order intake in the last quarter' and that customers are lengthening procurement timelines (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ab-dynamics--abdp/trading-update/9689877). It is the same issuer, but a different document.

findings.finding: The eMpulse acquisition (3-year average revenue $8.4m, adjusted operating profit $1.4m, H1 CY26 recovering, 'earnings enhancing') adds roughly £6m of inorganic FY27 revenue. That props up the FY27 statement the market will read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No standalone reaction recorded; the acquisition was announced 2026-08-20 and is not in the baseline's results-day history.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, because analysts will have added it. What remains is how management frames FY27 including eMpulse. If it were fully in the price, the release's FY27 framing would carry no information. Sized small for that reason.

findings.finding: FY26 cash conversion will print weak. Net cash fell from £41.7m at 30 Jun to £24.5m at 31 Aug, and only about £8.1m of that is the eMpulse initial consideration plus the final Venshure payment. The rest is the year-end working-capital build the company flagged in July.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean ABDP precedent. The cash line has previously printed strong (FY25 conversion 106%).
findings.why_not_priced: The net cash figure is public and the working-capital build was pre-flagged, so most of this is priced. The conversion percentage and the operating cash figure are not out yet. Sized near 0.
findings.independence: Pre-close net cash of £24.5m and the eMpulse/Venshure payments (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ab-dynamics--abdp/pre-close-trading-update/9776214).

findings.finding: Ownership flow since the warning tilts mildly to buyers. The CEO and interim CFO bought on 20 Aug at 804p and again on 25 Sep at 823.6p, after the pre-close. Perpetual/JOHCM (3.34%, 21 Sep) and Artemis (3.08%, 8 Oct) filed TR-1s with no previous position listed, consistent with crossing 3% upward. Earlier, Rathbones cut from 6.41% to 3.78% (9 Sep) and Octopus from 10.98% to 9.99% (14 Aug).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no measured reaction to director dealing for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: These are small purchases (600 shares each on 25 Sep) and the TR-1 direction is inferred. They are public, but a signal from management that FY27 is not deteriorating further is not fully reflected in a stock that drifted 3.6% below the insiders' September buy price.
findings.independence: Artemis TR-1 (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ab-dynamics--abdp/holding-s-in-company/9816173) and Perpetual TR-1 (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ab-dynamics--abdp/holding-s-in-company/9787760). Rathbones (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ab-dynamics--abdp/holding-s-in-company/9766437) and Octopus (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ab-dynamics--abdp/holding-s-in-company/9725961) point the other way.

findings.finding: The interim dividend was raised 10% to 3.08p, 'reflecting the Board's confidence'. That makes a progressive final dividend (the FY25 final was 6.36p) the default, and a cut or freeze would signal FY27 caution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to the dividend line.
findings.why_not_priced: The final dividend is not yet declared. It is a small line with a yield near 1%.
findings.independence: The FY25 final results record a total dividend up 20% (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/ab-dynamics--abdp/final-results/9224953).
